jdoe_acme: Hey — since this morning our private endpoint to Redwood is failing through our corporate LB. App logs show handshake errors and higher latency. We rolled the LB upgrade last night.

maria_support: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the curl/openssl output you see? Also which hostname are you hitting (SNI matters).

jdoe_acme: Hitting private-api.acme.internal (we terminate TLS at the LB). curl output: `curl -v https://private-api.acme.internal/health` ->
* Rebuilt URL to: https://private-api.acme.internal/health
*   Trying 10.4.1.12...
* Connected to private-api.acme.internal (10.4.1.12) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake to 10.4.1.12 failed: SSL: TLSv1 alert protocol version
* Closing connection 0

maria_support: That message typically means the client and server couldn't agree on a TLS protocol version or cipher. Since you TLS-terminate at the LB, the LB->Redwood connection is the critical hop. Can you run these from an internal host to reproduce and paste results?

maria_support: ```
openssl s_client -connect 10.4.1.12:443 -servername private-api.acme.internal -tls1_3
openssl s_client -connect 10.4.1.12:443 -servername private-api.acme.internal -tls1_2 -ciphers 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256'
```

jdoe_acme: Ran both. TLS1.3 attempt immediately fails with `no protocols available` and TLS1.2 attempt returns a cert for `default.internal` (LB default), not our SNI host. Output snippet for TLS1.2: 

```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = default.internal
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=default.internal
   i:/CN=corp-lb-ca
---
SSL handshake has read 1543 bytes and written 512 bytes
---
New, TLSv1/SSLv3, Cipher is ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
Server public key is 2048 bit
---
```

leo_sre: Two red flags: 1) LB is returning a default cert (SNI not forwarded or server selection failed), 2) TLS1.3 is not negotiated (LB likely running older OpenSSL/HAProxy). If the LB terminates TLS and then opens a new TLS session to Redwood, it needs to support ECDHE ciphers and ideally TLS1.3.

akshay_network: Confirming — our infra team saw the LB image was rolled to an older vendor build during the upgrade window that disables TLS1.3 by default and rewrites SNI under certain policies for inspection. That explains both failures.

maria_support: For mitigation options:
- If you can switch the LB to TCP passthrough for that route, SNI will reach Redwood and we can serve the correct cert.
- Or enable ECDHE+TLS1.2/TLS1.3 cipher suites on the LB and disable SNI rewrite/inspection for this host.
- As a short-term workaround, we can accept TLS1.2 ECDHE ciphers from the LB if you enable them; we do not support RSA key-exchange-only ciphers.

maria_support: Example LB acl/ssl config we saw work in other customers (HAProxy style):
```
frontend https-in
  mode tcp
  bind *:443
  acl is_private hdr(host) -i private-api.acme.internal
  use_backend private_passthrough if is_private

backend private_passthrough
  mode tcp
  server redwood-gw redwood-internal-host:443 send-proxy-v2
```

tim_engr: On our side, Redwood origin expects SNI and supports TLS1.3 + ECDHE TLS1.2. We can temporarily open a compatibility listener that permits TLS1.2 ECDHE-only and logs the negotiated ciphers to help debugging. Would you like us to enable that for a short window?

jdoe_acme: Yes please enable the compatibility listener. We can try passthrough as a config change too but that needs change window approval.

deploy-bot: [deploy] enabling compatibility listener on private-api.redwood.internal for 2 hours (will log ciphers) — started at 2025-05-12T15:22:10Z

leo_sre: Thanks — once the listener is up, can you re-run `openssl s_client -connect 10.4.1.12:443 -servername private-api.acme.internal -tls1_2 -cipher 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256'` and paste the new `Cipher` line? Also grep our logs for `CIPHER_NEGOTIATED` flag.

jdoe_acme: Re-tested after your change — TLS1.2 now succeeds and shows `Cipher is ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256`. No more default cert. App integration tests pass for 10 minutes then we've scheduled the LB config change for the maintenance window.

maria_support: Great. Long-term we recommend enabling TLS1.3 on the LB or using TCP passthrough + SNI to avoid double-termination. Also remove the SNI rewrite/inspection rule for endpoints that require client SNI.

akshay_network: We'll roll the LB change in the window and confirm with a quick smoke run. If anything flaps, we'll open a ticket and loop you in.

jdoe_acme: Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround. Please keep logs of the negotiated ciphers in case this returns.

maria_support: Noted. Escalating the thread to network engineering for the LB policy change and marking as P1 until post-deploy verification.

leo_sre: Adding a note: if you can't avoid TLS termination at the LB, ensure it supports at least these ciphers: `TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256`, `TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256`, `ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256`. Redwood will reject legacy RSA-KEX ciphers.

jdoe_acme: Understood. Closing once LB deploy is green.

maria_support: Thanks — follow-up in #support-log after the maintenance window. :white_check_mark:
